stem: Which of the following best describes a transport network?
options: A fleet of vehicles owned by a single transport company
Several nodes joined by a series of links forming a pattern
A single long route connecting two major ports of a country
The staff who handle loading, unloading and delivery of goods
explanation: Correct option: (B). The chapter defines a transport network as several places (nodes) joined together by a series of routes (links) to form a pattern. A fleet of vehicles (A) and the handling staff (D) are parts of the transport industry, not the network itself, and a single route (C) is only one link, not a pattern of links.
